headline: RAF 1 Commando Scrim Team Secures Sponsorship Deal

body.text: RAF 1 Commando Scrim Team Secures Sponsorship Deal

In news that has shocked absolutely no one following recent events at Tournament Grounds, RAF 1 Commando's Scrim Team has today announced a landmark sponsorship agreement with Fish News and tacteam, with kit generously supplied by SlimeStore.

The deal, reportedly negotiated over the course of a single phone call and what witnesses describe as "an uncomfortably long silence," sees the Commandos become the most heavily backed outfit in the region, a development several rival teams have called "inevitable".

Fish News, never ones to shy away from a good story (particularly one about themselves), confirmed the partnership in a statement dripping with characteristic humility: "We didn't choose RAF 1 Commando. The scoreboard chose them for us. We simply followed the numbers, and the numbers led here."
Tacteam, joining as co-sponsor, were somewhat more measured in their praise, noting only that "a 750–101 scoreline tends to answer most of the due diligence questions."

SlimeStore, meanwhile, will be outfitting the entire squad with new uniforms, with a spokesperson confirming the kit had been "engineered for flanking manoeuvres specifically," in what many are calling a not-so-subtle nod to recent events. When asked whether this was a deliberate dig at the 75th Rangers, the spokesperson simply smiled and said nothing further.

RAF 1 Commando's commanding officer, visibly trying to contain his enthusiasm, offered the following statement: "We're incredibly grateful to Fish News, Tacteam, and Slimestore for believing in us. Or, more accurately, for watching the last scrim and doing the maths themselves."
Fish News will continue reporting on this developing partnership with the objectivity and restraint for which it has become world-renowned.
